title: YuE2 · Frontier Music with Symbolic Planning
excerpt: YuE2 unifies symbolic and audio music generation at frontier quality. Symbolic planning turns lyrics and style into an editable score, then a full song with vocals and accompaniment.

Model & Results

YuE2 (best-of-8) reaches 6.9632 on SongBench, the highest observed mean among 17 evaluated settings on WildSongBench (192 prompts). Suno v5 scores 6.8721 in the same comparison. Suno v6 and Suno v6 Wild score 6.5562 and 6.4195, respectively.

Explore benchmark scores WildSongBench · 17 settings · 9 metrics

WildSongBench192 prompts

WildSongBench · SongBench
RankSystem / settingPromptsSongBench ↑
How to read these results

WildSongBench. 192 prompts, 17 system settings, and the paper’s nine automatic metrics. SongBench averages all seven dimensions; SongEval averages all five. Musicality is also reported separately for each evaluator. Both YuE2 settings use melody-and-chord symbolic planning.

Selection. YuE2, the public baselines, and Suno v6 and v6 Wild use two candidates and four ASR repeats per candidate, followed by lower-PER selection. Earlier proprietary outputs retain their delivered-candidate protocols. YuE2 best-of-8 selects from eight generations using SongBench Musicality, then Q3O Control, then PER. The comparison therefore retains different selection budgets.

State of the art on MARBLE

MERT2-30s and MERT2-FS (full-song) achieve SOTA on 14 of 15 MARBLE metrics, leading across tagging, key, genre, and emotion recognition.

Training data
